design_philosophy.vibe: Trust-building, structured, very clean, highly functional with a premium feel to justify payment. Emphasis on 'Norwegian Design': minimalist but warm, deeply reliant on high-quality typography, clear hierarchy, and negative space.
core_principles: Trust First: Use clear, unambiguous layouts. BankID badges must stand out but feel seamlessly integrated.
Organic Accents: Root the app in physical craft (stone, wood, steel) via colors, avoiding tech-clichés.
Clear Hierarchies: The contrast between the free user (customer) and paying user (craftsmen) should feel distinct yet unified.
Macro-padding: Use p-8 to p-12 minimum for core sections to create a premium, uncrowded feel.

rules: No Inter for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for a sturdy, trustworthy feel.
H1 up to text-5xl, H2 up to text-3xl, tracking-tight on all headings.
Labels must be text-xs, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em].
Do not exceed text-6xl for hero headings.

layouts.general: Bento grids for job listings and dashboard. Strong asymmetrical grids for marketing/landing views.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing system. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have padding to avoid text collision.
layouts.cards: Solid trust format. Flat background (white or very light warm grey), 1px subtle border (border-border), rounded-lg max. No muddy shadows.
layouts.navigation: Clear, distinct, solid background or crystal glass. No fully transparent headers.
layouts.grid_technical: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers. Mobile-first responsive grids.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Primary uses #1C3F60, clear hover state (lighter hue or text color change).
components.badges: BankID badge must be distinct using the success green or a reliable blue.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Standardize on solid borders. Never use native html date pickers.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications (e.g., job posted, bid placed) located in /src/components/ui/sonner.js.
components.interactions: Micro-animations on all interactive elements. Hover, focus (with high contrast rings), and press states.
components.general: All components must be .js based. Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for standard UI, Phosphor Icons if duotone/premium needed.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations (staggered lists of jobs), page transitions.

image_urls.description: A carpenter in a dusty workshop precisely cuts wood using an industrial saw.
A modern Scandinavian living room filled with furniture and lots of windows.
Smiling couple receiving keys, celebrating new home purchase indoors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Focus states must have high contrast rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='post-job-button') to facilitate robust automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Håndverkerknappen' platform focusing on a robust frontend React UI (.js files) and FastAPI backend.
Ensure BankID verification badge is prominent on verified craftsmen profiles and listings.
Display Vipps and Stripe UI elements for payment (setup simulated endpoints, do not process real charges yet).
Use solid components, avoid card overuse. Lean towards dense, high-hierarchy lists for job boards.
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects. Use Shadcn components for all interactive logic.
Apply generous padding (p-6, p-8) to all containers.
Center-align is banned for layouts; use left-aligned, asymmetrical grids (Bento style).
Create the specific email templates for the Resend integration in the frontend UI or backend module.
Ensure the affiliate products module is integrated contextually.
Use the provided image URLs as placeholders instead of generic text or grey boxes.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Provide clear feedback for every action (e.g., successful job post, bid placement) using toasts.
Mobile-first design is mandatory. Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44px.
Maintain a clear distinction between customer (free) flows and craftsman (paid) flows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Add hover, active, and focus states to all interactive elements.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT messy shadows.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Do NOT leave components half-implemented. Follow through with proper responsive mobile-first Tailwind classes.
